cases.finding: Centralized app distribution can reduce distribution/trust friction and scale complements while concentrating governance. This attacks any one-direction openness prior; it supports conditionality rather than a fixed platform policy.

A restrictive abstraction can create major capability precisely by hiding large machinery. Reality/Representation separation does not mean representations should be weak or that hidden machinery is semantically irrelevant.
System-cost decline is co-produced by module manufacturing, deployment, policy and soft-cost change. Laboratory technical performance is not the unique or stable frontier bottleneck.
Durable clinical benefit can coexist with severe immune toxicity and non-immediate response patterns. One short-horizon efficacy/toxicity metric cannot stand for therapeutic value.
The exact lightweight source contract does not justify the planned option-value inference strongly enough. The anti-case is therefore retained as pressure but not used to increment HD2-N2.

interpretation: Failure to obtain a clean contradiction after seven epochs increases falsifiability/codebook pressure. Anti-case survival cannot be converted into universality evidence.
